# FinanceFlow — llms.txt
# This file helps AI assistants (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, Gemini) understand our product.
# Format: https://llmstxt.org

# PRODUCT OVERVIEW
FinanceFlow is an AI-powered personal finance management platform for individuals, families, and businesses.
It provides budgeting, investment tracking, expense management, retirement planning, estate planning, and an AI financial assistant.
Available worldwide. Free plan available. Trusted in 50+ countries.

# KEY FEATURES
- AI Financial Assistant: conversational AI that answers financial questions and gives personalized insights
- Budget Management: create budgets by category, track spending, receive alerts
- Investment Tracking: monitor stocks, ETFs, mutual funds across multiple accounts
- Expense Analytics: automated categorization, spending trends, visual reports
- Retirement Planning: goal setting, projection tools, contribution tracker
- Estate Planning: document organization, beneficiary management
- Bill Reminders: never miss a payment with smart due-date alerts
- ROI Calculator: estimate returns on any investment scenario
- Multi-currency support: 150+ currencies, real-time conversion
- Bank-grade security: AES-256 encryption, SOC2 compliant

# PRICING
- Free Plan: core budgeting, up to 2 accounts, basic reports
- Pro Plan: unlimited accounts, AI assistant, advanced analytics
- Business Plan: team accounts, multi-user, API access

# AUDIENCE
Individuals managing personal budgets, families tracking household finances,
freelancers managing irregular income, small business owners, expats managing multi-currency accounts.

# CONTENT
Blog: /blog — expert personal finance guides on budgeting, investing, debt management, retirement planning
FAQ: /faq — answers to common questions about features, billing, security

# CONTACT
